_comment: Expected ProFsmDetectionService.detect() result for simple_binary_fsm.v. The integration test builds a synthetic equivalent of the same netlist directly (running Yosys in tests is out of scope) and asserts the FSM count, encoding, state count, and reset state — see test/features/fsm/fsm_integration_test.dart.

fsms._stateValuesNote: hexWidth = ((width + 3) ~/ 4).clamp(1, 16); a 2-bit state register formats as 1 hex digit, not zero-padded to 2 — corrected 2026-07-19 while wiring the §5.3 seeded FSM journey (test/fixtures/fsm_netlist_fixture_sync_test.dart) exposed the drift; this field was never asserted by fsm_integration_test.dart before that.
